comment: With !verbose, a count typed before an item letter in the inventory menu selects part of the stack, but invent.c dispinv_with_action() passes only the object to itemactions(), so "Drop this stack" drops all four tripe rations after a count of 3. invent.c ddoinv() calls dispinv_with_action(), which hands the picked item to iactions.c itemactions(), whose itemactions_pushkeys() queues the command and the item letter, and invent.c getobj() takes the letter from cmdq_pop() without a prompt.
